## Appearance

Stella Maynard is a vivid individual with black eyes. She harbors a heart filled with wistful dreams and fancies.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## Personality

Stella Maynard is an ambitious student characterized by her thoughtful and imaginative nature. Known as the "rose-red" girl, she is part of a close circle of friends at the [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) who share similar reflective and creative qualities.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) before spending time working as a schoolteacher. Looking ahead to her next year of college, she proposed renting a house with [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), suggesting her [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) act as their housekeeper. The group, joined by [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md), successfully secured Patty's Place and settled into a lively household together for the school year. During their time living at Patty's Place, Stella and her housemates balanced their [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) examinations with household antics, social calls, and creative endeavors, including a rainy afternoon spent with [Anne](../character/anne.md) reading old melodramatic stories. As their college life drew to a close after graduation, Stella packed up her belongings alongside her friends as they prepared to part ways.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P2](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P9](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P11](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P13](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. ## Quotes

> "I love Anne and I like Roy. Everybody says she is making a brilliant match, and even Mrs. Gardner thinks her charming now. It all sounds as if it were made in heaven, but I have my doubts. Make the most of that, Aunt Jamesina."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Dawn P16](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0016)

> "I was afraid they’d come back. And then our jolly little nest here would be broken up—and we poor callow nestlings thrown out on the cruel world of boardinghouses again."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Confidences P10](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0010)

> "Nothing seems worthwhile. My very thoughts are old. I’ve thought them all before. What is the use of living after all, Anne?"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P31](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0031)

> "Oh, my mind agrees with you, Anne. But my soul remains doleful and uninspired. I’m always grubby and dingy on rainy nights."
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Opens P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)

> "Philippa Gordon! I never thought you were utterly unfeeling. The idea of you saying you’d love to break a man’s heart!"
>
> — Stella Maynard — [v3 ch.Charming P20](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0020)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Anne](../character/anne.md) are intimate friends who first bonded during their time studying at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). They keep in close touch through correspondence while [Anne](../character/anne.md) teaches in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), sharing humorous stories, classroom anecdotes, and news about mutual acquaintances. They later reunite during their university years to set up a shared home together at Patty's Place alongside other close companions.

- Friend of — intimate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), +4 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are intimate friends who formed a close relationship while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) together. Their bond continues at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), where Stella proposes that they live together and helps establish their shared household at Patty's Place alongside their college friends. Together, they manage domestic mishaps, prepare for exams, and support each other through major life milestones until graduation.

- Friend of — intimate friends and fellow students at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

### [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

Stella and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) are intimate friends who formed part of the same close-knit student circle during their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Their friendship continues into their college years, leading Stella to propose that [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), and herself rent Patty's Place together with Stella's aunt serving as housekeeper. They share a cozy domestic life and support one another through their studies and personal lives throughout their years living together.

- Friend of — circle of intimate friends at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 ch.Friend P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
